name: Text Renderer
description: Canvas 2D text measurement and rendering utility wrapping @chenglou/pretext. Provides static methods for measuring text height, drawing wrapped text onto a canvas context, creating single-style HTMLCanvasElement from text, and creating multi-style canvas from array of styled line segments. Handles device pixel ratio for sharp rendering.

functions.name: measure
functions.signature: (text: string, font: string, maxWidth: number): number
functions.description: Measures the rendered height of text when laid out with the given font and max width.

functions.name: draw
functions.signature: (ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, text: string, x: number, y: number, maxWidth: number, style: TextStyle): void
functions.description: Draws wrapped text onto a canvas context at the given coordinates using prepareWithSegments() and layoutWithLines().

functions.name: createCanvas
functions.signature: (text: string, width: number, height: number, style: TextStyle): HTMLCanvasElement
functions.description: Creates an HTMLCanvasElement with text rendered in a single style, scaled for device pixel ratio.

functions.name: createCanvas2
functions.signature: (lines: { text: string; style: TextStyle }[], width: number, height: number): HTMLCanvasElement
functions.description: Creates an HTMLCanvasElement with multiple styled line segments, each potentially using different fonts/colors. Computes line heights and stacks them vertically.

types.name: TextStyle
types.definition: interface TextStyle { font: string; color: string; lineHeight?: number; }
types.description: Style descriptor for text rendering including font CSS string, fill color, and optional line height.
